The '''Seat of The Empire''' was a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The region existed as an astrographical and [[Politics/Legends|political]] center for the reconstituted [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the centuries following the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], and encompassed a number of other smaller sectors within its borders. It was located in the northeastern corner of the galaxy and bordered [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] along its southeastern boundary. Some of the sectors included within the region were the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] and the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]]. The area was native to the [[Rakghoul]] mutants of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], the original [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] found on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and the [[Hybrid/Legends|hybridized]] descendants of those Sith. Immigrated [[Species/Legends|species]] included [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], and [[Epicanthix]], as well as a myriad of other [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] that were brought in by the Sith's [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trade.

The Seat of The Empire grew from the expansionary efforts of the Empire during its post-Hyperspace War reconstruction process, but drastically increased in size and prominence after [[3681 BBY]], when the Empire revealed itself to the larger galaxy and began a campaign of domination launched from the region. After this [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-controlled Seat of the Empire was recognized as one of five major sectors of activity in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], as it hosted the Sith holy [[Planet/Legends|world]] of Korriban, their [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], and the symbolically-important planet Taris.
